com.codedstream.otterstream.context
 
  • Classes in com.codedstream.otterstream.context used by com.codedstream.otterstream.context
    Class
    Description
    Context
    The assembled output of ContextEngine.assemble(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>): every configured provider's result, namespaced by provider id so two providers can never silently clobber each other's keys, plus a flattened merged view for the common case where callers just want one map to feed into feature extraction.
    ContextCache
    Bounded, TTL-based cache for assembled Contexts, keyed by the request key (entity id, session id, etc.) — the "Context Cache" layer: avoid re-assembling context (parallel provider fan-out, each with its own network round trip) on every request when the underlying context hasn't changed since the last one.
    ContextEngine
    Assembles context from every configured ContextProvider in parallel before inference — the entry point for otter-stream-context.
    ContextEngine.Builder
     
    ContextResult
    One provider's contribution to an assembled Context — its data (if it succeeded), how long it took, and its failure (if it didn't).
